"""A module that reads the environment directly. Real code may not do this once G2 lands; kept
here as the fixture's violation case for env_reads_outside_settings."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os


def read_domain_from_env() -> str:
    """VIOLATION: env_reads_outside_settings -- an env read outside settings.py."""
    return os.environ.get("KF_DEV_DOMAIN", "")
